citation.title: Real-time CXRS analysis on HL-3 tokamak with reliable neural networks and cross-device transfer learning
citation.authors: Tian W., Yang Z., Long T., Yang S., Wu H., Yu D., He X., Tang C., Ke R., Xu M., Gao Z., Chen W., Zhong W., Shi Z.
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1741-4326/aeb037 (this paper's own DOI, PDF p2 header)

scope_read.limitations: Figure values were read visually. No code or data were available. Validation-set construction inside the folds is not specified.

claim_checks.source_finding: The paper measures offline inference time: 0.56 ms per 32-channel profile on an RTX 4090 with an i7 CPU, and 5.6 ms for a 10-model ensemble. The authors define 'real-time' as removing the fitting bottleneck. They state that the 25 ms CCD exposure exceeds the roughly 10 ms control requirement and that hardware upgrades would be needed.
claim_checks.locator: p2 §1 (final paragraphs); p5 §3.2; p6 Table 3 and text; p14 §6 (third limitation) and App. A
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Neural-network readers of CXRS spectra can cut per-profile analysis time to sub-millisecond GPU inference on HL-3, although diagnostic cadence remains set by camera exposure [Tian].
claim_checks.qualification: No plasma-control-system integration and no end-to-end latency were reported.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: Labels are conventional fits, not independent truth
claim_checks.source_finding: Labels come from least-squares multi-Gaussian fits with human inspection of each spectrum. The authors acknowledge that accuracy depends on label quality. Cross-checks against stored energy, SX, Thomson scattering and XICS are described as qualitative or limited.
claim_checks.locator: p3 §2.1–2.2; p13 §6 (first limitation); p15 App. A, Figs A1–A2
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Such readers are trained to reproduce conventionally fitted, expert-screened CXRS results.
claim_checks.qualification: Agreement with these labels is not agreement with physical Ti.

claim_checks.source_finding: Outermost channels 1–4 degrade (Ti MRE about 10–30%), attributed to low SNR, pcx/ei overlap and only 300–1000 samples per channel. The pedestal channels 5–8 perform close to mid-radius levels. MC-dropout uncertainty is elevated at both the edge and the hot core, and channel-averaged uncertainty correlates with absolute error (r>0.9).
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Reported accuracy of spectrum readers varies across radius and degrades where signal and training data are sparse near the edge [Tian].
claim_checks.qualification: These are HL-3 channel results and do not transfer to our KSTAR pedestal-top chord.

input_target_timing.inputs: Current-frame single-channel 200-pixel CXRS spectrum (baseline-subtracted, z-scored) plus a channel index
input_target_timing.outputs: Ti (keV) and vt for the same frame
input_target_timing.causal_or_offline: Same-frame spectral inversion. There is no temporal forecasting or nowcasting.
input_target_timing.source_diagnostic_as_input: Yes: the CXRS spectrum itself is the input
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: The model reproduces fitted labels, not physical truth

validation.split_unit: Discharge-level; repeated 5-fold CV ×3 over 190 HL-3 shots (11974–13669)
validation.independent_truth: None; cross-diagnostic consistency checks only (App. A)
validation.unknowns: How the early-stopping validation set relates to the test fold. No untouched hold-out campaign. No confidence intervals beyond fold/seed SD and paired t-tests.

runtime_or_deployment.what_was_measured: GPU inference time per profile, single model and ensemble
runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: Acquisition-to-output latency, data transfer, PCS deployment, and actual report-arrival timing

forbidden_inferences: The model was deployed in real-time control
HL-3 edge or pedestal accuracy applies to KSTAR
The paper nowcasts a CES report before its spectrum is available
Transfer-learning gains generalise to other devices without alignment
Our method improves on this one in any respect
competing_or_complementary: Complementary upstream spectrum reader. It shortens fitting latency and could refresh anchors for a downstream temporal nowcast, possibly reducing that nowcast's marginal value. This interaction was untested by both works. It uses no BES/ECEI and does not address the interval between reports.
